maps.name: Roadside camp (night)
maps.description: The same wagon camp at night, lit by a campfire and a few torches. Use it for Marker Nine at dusk and night, and any roadside camp after dark.

maps.name: Roadside camp (day)
maps.description: A wagon camp beside the Lantern Road in daylight: a campfire ring, tents, logs and a few trees. Use it for Marker Nine, any roadside camp or a rest stop, in daylight.

maps.name: Thornwood trail (roadside)
maps.description: A winding dirt road through woods and meadow with a steep earth bank on each side, thickets of dense bushes that hide creatures, boulders and a fallen log. Use it for a roadside ambush, a bandit toll, a wrecked wagon or a meeting in the trees.

maps.name: Old Tollhouse cellars
maps.description: A torch-lit stone cellar complex under an abandoned tollhouse: an entry hall with stairs up, a pillared chamber with a brazier, storerooms, a flagstone corridor and doors. Use it for the tollhouse, any old cellar, a vault or a hideout under a building.

maps.name: The Sunken Chapel (crypt)
maps.description: A torch-lit stone crypt under a ruined chapel: an entry hall with a staircase and pillars, a large pillared chamber with an altar and a brazier, a sarcophagus room with four tombs and a wooden storeroom with crates. Use it for the Sunken Chapel and any old crypt or shrine vault.
